in_marathi.name: Kavyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Intelligent, Scholar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kavya means 'poetry' or 'wisdom' and Ansh means 'essence' or 'manifestation'. This name signifies a wise, intelligent and knowledgeable individual who embodies the essence of poetry and wisdom.
